title: The users surface, the org switcher and the invite path honour the elicited tenancy shape
asA: shelf consumer applying application-admin-console with the tenancy capability applied and a tenancy-shape chosen
iWant: the directory, the switcher and org-scoped invites to obey the per-user, per-org or both shape
soThat: the org boundaries the platform enforces are the boundaries the console renders and refuses across

acceptanceCriteria.description: When tenancy-shape is `per-user`, every directory row carries exactly one data-org-id and the org switcher renders exactly one org for the current principal; a per-org action from the switcher list beyond the principal's org is refused with TENANCY_SHAPE_REFUSAL naming the shape.
acceptanceCriteria.when: the users route and the org switcher render
acceptanceCriteria.then: each users row carries exactly one data-org-id, the switcher lists exactly one org, and a switch to another org refuses with TENANCY_SHAPE_REFUSAL

acceptanceCriteria.description: When tenancy-shape is `per-org`, every directory row carries data-org-membership=all and the switcher renders every org the current principal can reach; an org-scoped invite adds the invitee to the currently switched org without touching the other orgs the principal already belongs to.
acceptanceCriteria.when: the users route renders and an admin invites into the currently switched org
acceptanceCriteria.then: each users row carries data-org-membership=all, the switcher enumerates every reachable org, and the invite POST records the invitee against exactly the switched org (verified in the audit stream)

acceptanceCriteria.description: When tenancy-shape is `both`, each directory row carries data-org-scope=single or data-org-scope=many and an org-scoped invite for a `many` principal presents an org-picker for the invitee's target orgs; a `single` principal cannot be invited into more than one org.
acceptanceCriteria.when: the users route renders and an admin invites
acceptanceCriteria.then: rows carry data-org-scope=single or data-org-scope=many, a `many` invitee shows an org-picker, and a `single` invitee cannot be given multiple orgs (the picker refuses)

acceptanceCriteria.description: A cross-org action (deactivate, role-change) the elicited shape does not allow refuses at the console with TENANCY_SHAPE_REFUSAL naming the shape and the refused action; the underlying principal directory API is not called.
acceptanceCriteria.given: any tenancy-shape applied and an admin attempts an action outside the shape
acceptanceCriteria.then: the console refuses with TENANCY_SHAPE_REFUSAL naming the shape and the action, and no request reaches the principal directory

acceptanceCriteria.description: The rendered directory always agrees with the applied shape: a users row rendered with data-org-membership=all under tenancy-shape=per-user refuses to render (data-error=SHAPE_MISMATCH is written to the console log and the row is suppressed) rather than presenting the wrong shape.
acceptanceCriteria.given: tenancy applied and a mismatched row surfaces from the principal directory
acceptanceCriteria.then: the row is suppressed and data-error=SHAPE_MISMATCH is emitted
